name: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
source:
A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing is a murder-mystery visual novel that takes place in a French high school. You play as Mercredi, an aloof teenage girl who finds that her life is quickly and continuously going awry when your friend goes missing.

[From [url=https://harlequinngames.itch.io/a-wolf-in-sheeps-clothing]Itch.io[/url]]
